section_2.title: From interest to application in four clear steps.
section_2.description: YStudy keeps the process practical. You do not need to know the perfect degree before you start — we help you choose, check and apply.

cards.title: Choose a direction
cards.description: Tell us your goals, work background and subject interests. We shortlist realistic degree routes.

cards.title: Check eligibility
cards.description: We look at residency, previous study, qualifications and Student Finance questions before you waste time.

cards.title: Prepare documents
cards.description: You receive a clear checklist for ID, status, qualifications, CV or personal statement.

cards.title: Submit and enrol
cards.description: We support your application steps, interview preparation and enrolment communication.
